'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Scott Lingrell DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Knowledge And Defense (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-knowledgeanddefense-pre.gif|label=Knowledge And Defense (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
